{{- $title := cond .IsHome (printf "%s — email from the command line" site.Title) (printf "%s · %s" .Title site.Title) }} {{- $description := or .Description .Summary site.Params.description | plainify | htmlUnescape | strings.TrimSpace | truncate 180 }} {{ $title }} {{- /* Apply the color theme before the first paint (no flash): the saved choice, else the operating system's preference. */}} {{- $uikit := resources.Get "vendor/uikit/css/uikit.min.css" }} {{- $site := slice (resources.Get "css/chroma-light.css") (resources.Get "css/chroma-dark.css") (resources.Get "css/site.css") (resources.Get "css/manpage.css") | resources.Concat "css/site.css" }} {{- if hugo.IsProduction }} {{- $uikit = $uikit | fingerprint }} {{- $site = $site | minify | fingerprint }} {{- end }}
